Behind the sky

A universe in
little characters.

Nightfall is a small, generative escape. Every star and every crater on the moon is drawn with ordinary text characters, arranged into something a little less ordinary.

Change the moon, scatter a few more stars, or hide the controls and stay awhile. There’s nothing to finish here.

An imagined sky, not an astronomical forecast.
*The characters are drawn on a digital canvas.
